title: Enterprise Lab: Network Monitoring and NetFlow
scenario: Implement SNMP monitoring and logging for network device health and alerts

errors.solution: Check export interface, destination IP, and port.
Increase cache size or reduce active timeout.
Verify sampler attached to monitor and ratio appropriate.

questions.question: Difference between active and inactive timeout?
questions.solution: Active: long-lived flows timeout. Inactive: idle flows timeout.

steps.title: Enable NetFlow on Router0
steps.instruction: Enable NetFlow version 9 on Router0 and configure the flow exporter to send flows to the collector.

commonErrors.solution: Check exporter destination IP and UDP port 2055

steps.title: Create NetFlow Monitor and Record
steps.instruction: Create a flow monitor with IPv4 traffic record to capture source/destination IP, ports, and protocol.

commonErrors.solution: Verify exporter attached to monitor with exporter command

steps.title: Apply NetFlow Monitor to Router0 Interfaces
steps.instruction: Apply the NetFlow monitor to Router0 LAN interface (Gi0/0) in both input and output directions.

commonErrors.solution: Apply both input and output for bidirectional capture

steps.challenge: Apply to WAN interface as well

steps.title: Configure NetFlow Timeout Values
steps.instruction: Set active and inactive timeout values for flow cache management.

commonErrors.solution: Reduce active timeout or increase cache size

steps.title: Verify NetFlow Export to Collector
steps.instruction: Generate traffic from PC0 to PC1 and verify flows are exported to the collector at 192.168.1.100.
steps.expectedOutput: Flows visible in cache and export statistics incrementing

commonErrors.solution: Check collector IP, UDP 2055, and interface application

steps.challenge: Analyze top talkers from flow cache

steps.title: Configure NetFlow Top Talkers
steps.instruction: Enable NetFlow top talkers feature to identify bandwidth consumers.
steps.expectedOutput: Top 10 talkers displayed sorted by bytes

commonErrors.solution: Generate traffic and wait for cache population

steps.challenge: Sort by packets instead of bytes

steps.title: Configure NetFlow Aggregation for Protocol Analysis
steps.instruction: Configure protocol-port aggregation to analyze traffic by protocol and port.

commonErrors.solution: Wait for cache population after enabling

steps.title: Verify NetFlow Statistics and Export
steps.instruction: Run comprehensive verification of NetFlow configuration and export statistics.
commands: show flow monitor NETFLOW_MONITOR cache format table
steps.expectedOutput: Export packets sent, flows in cache, export statistics incrementing

commonErrors.solution: Verify exporter destination reachable, UDP 2055 not blocked

hints: Flows exported should match cache entries

steps.title: Configure NetFlow Sampling for High-Volume Traffic
steps.instruction: Enable deterministic sampling (1:100) to reduce CPU load on high-speed interfaces.

commonErrors.solution: Attach sampler to monitor with sampler command

steps.title: Final NetFlow Verification and Documentation
steps.instruction: Run final comprehensive verification, document configuration, and save.
commands: show flow monitor NETFLOW_MONITOR cache format table
steps.expectedOutput: Complete NetFlow configuration documented and saved

topology: Router0 -> Switch0 -> PC0\nRouter0 -> Switch0 -> PC1\nRouter0 -> Collector (192.168.1.100)
prerequisites: Basic routing/switching knowledge, IP addressing fundamentals
